intro: One glass of Milo ais from a kedai has about 200 kcal (estimate). Calories come from the chocolate malt powder and condensed milk mixed in.

variants.name: Milo without condensed milk (Milo O ais)

diet: Yes, but treat Milo ais like a snack, not just a drink. 200 kcal is about the same as one roti canai kosong. If you love it, enjoy it a few times a week and count it in your daily calories. The ones to really watch are the dinosaur version and the jumbo glass.
tips: Order 'Milo kurang manis' or ask for no condensed milk.
Make Milo ais your 'afternoon snack', don't add kuih on top.
Make it at home with low-fat fresh milk and less powder.

swap.name: Milo O ais (no condensed milk)
swap.why: Still chocolatey, but almost half the calories.

faq.q: Is Milo ais good after exercise?
faq.a: It has carbs and a little protein, but the sugar is high. Real food like rice with a protein dish is more filling.

faq.q: What's the difference between Milo ais and Milo dinosaur?
faq.a: Milo dinosaur has a thick layer of powder sprinkled on top. Calories can go up to about 300 kcal.

faq.q: Is Milo okay for kids every day?
faq.a: Okay once in a while, but the sugar is high for a daily drink. Alternate with plain milk or plain water.
